title: Desert Monsters Drop Sand
description: Husks and Parched drop sand and red sand upon death, allowing them to be farmed.
body:
![A husk and a parched dying and dropping sand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe1e45f32488587a7c66d2f56f255bff0e7be42a.png)

___

Husks and parched drop 0-3 sand and 1-2 extra per level of looting.
- _1-5 sand with Looting I_
- _2-7 sand with Looting II_
- _3-9 sand with Looting III_

They have a 25% chance to drop **red** sand instead when on fire and +25% chance per level of fire aspect.
- _50% with Fire Aspect I_
- _75% with Fire Aspect II_

They always drop red sand when killed in a badlands biome.

___

*This is my take on many already existing packs that make husks drop sand. Parched now spawn alongside husks in desert biomes, meaning there's less space in the mob cap for husks to spawn, which would harm your sand rates. It's been almost six weeks since 1.21.11 released, and none of those datapacks have updated to include the parched, so I decided to do it myself.*
